context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly recognises a trivially small plan and skips the full 3-reviewer audit and model-selection question instead of over-applying the heavyweight process.

checklist.name: No subagents spawned
checklist.description: Technical/Strategic/Risk reviewers are not spawned for this plan

checklist.name: No model-selection question
checklist.description: Agent does not ask which models to use, since no reviewers run

checklist.name: Reason for skipping stated
checklist.description: Agent explicitly states the plan is too small to justify 3-subagent overhead

checklist.name: Frontmatter still checked
checklist.description: Frontmatter validity is still confirmed even though the full audit is skipped

checklist.name: Single direct opinion given
checklist.description: Agent gives one direct, proportionate opinion rather than a fabricated multi-section report

checklist.name: No fabricated report sections
checklist.description: No Model Configuration / Critical Issues / Scores sections invented for a review that didn't happen

checklist.name: Still useful
checklist.description: The direct opinion is substantive, not just 'looks fine' with no reasoning

checklist.name: Does not misclassify size
checklist.description: Agent does not claim this plan needs phases/waves it doesn't have

checklist.name: Consistent with skill's own threshold
checklist.description: Cites the '1 paragraph, no steps' / H2-count threshold from When NOT to Use rather than inventing a new rule

checklist.name: Offers full audit if wanted
checklist.description: Agent notes the user can ask for the full 3-reviewer audit if they actually want it
